module_step.title: Create Title Classifier watcher
module_step.description: Choose which Home Assistant entity should be watched and which category should be classified from it.

data.name: Watcher name
data.scope: Scope (same value on both instances = shared)
data.retention_days: How long should old entries be kept?

db.title: Media catalog database
db.description: Connection to the shared Postgres database (LXC 108). Asked only for the first watcher — later ones inherit it automatically.

artist.title: Select artist attribute
artist.description: Optional: choose the attribute that provides artist, author, or station name. If it does not fit, the integration falls back to known media attributes.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure watcher
reconfigure.description: Update this watcher's database connection and identity. The entry_id and local .storage data are kept.

data.scope: Scope (same value on both instances = shared)

data.auto_hide_hours: Automatically hide unclassified entries after hours (0 = off)
